items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: I joined another group called Tujac Spang... Henry Young, Fonson Price, who was now a day, played violin, second violin to Henry Young.

ctx.x: Yeah, but how long, I mean when was the last time though?

In 1938 I reorganized the band. When this music was being taken away from New Orleans, they were calling Chicago Swing. Benny Goodman was in the center then. And what he played, if you look at it, the St. Louis Blues is a copy for my cornet part and also Larry Shields' clarinet part. He had mixed to listen to the records of the original Lixieland Jazz Band when he was only eight years old. And I played, when I first started playing in a group, it would have been about 1904.
